head.name: @fzlt/core/match
head.lead: The match flow every game shares, intro → count → play → paused → end, on the Board UI kit's overlay (grey dim, a sticker that slams, at most two sticker keys). One overlay is built once; each phase only flips attributes, styles and text through the ledger, so destroy() gives the page back exactly. Every transition is an event on the ring (match:play, …), so the HUD, sound and coach layers react without knowing about this one. Pass null as the root to run the phase machine headless (tests, a server).

sizesNote: Measured on this build: minified and gzipped with everything it imports, the way npm run size checks the budget in CI.
